vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security releases bypass the maturation window here, but pnpm enforces its own 24-hour minimumReleaseAge at install time (pnpm-workspace.yaml). A CVE PR raised within that window cannot install until it lapses; when that happens, lower the pnpm-side window for the one install rather than removing it.

packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 is the native Go port and removes legacy compiler APIs (parseConfigFileTextToJson, readConfigFile) that Stryker's sandbox preprocessor calls. Holding at 6.x until Stryker supports it; revisit when stryker-js ships TS7 compatibility.
Dev tooling: automerge patch and minor once CI is green.
Let a release settle before adopting it, except for CVEs.
Group the toolchain so its parts move together.
Node itself is pinned by .nvmrc and moves deliberately.
